entities.name: The Cursemute
entities.description: A powerful ritual by Avacyn that transformed and suppressed Innistrad's curses.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel who cast the Cursemute and later fell to madness and was destroyed.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane afflicted by curses and monsters.

entities.name: Gatstaf
entities.description: Remote village whose people appealed for relief from lycanthropy.

entities.name: Gatstaf Grotto
entities.description: Where Avacyn appeared before the villagers.

entities.name: Wolfir
entities.description: Noble wolf-like protectors Avacyn made from willing werewolves.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church whose cause the Wolfir served.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker whose corruption by the Chain Veil was dulled by the Cursemute.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Artifact whose hold on Garruk was dulled.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: Prison that was sundered, releasing Avacyn.

events.summary: The villagers of Gatstaf plead for relief from lycanthropy.
events.quote: where the people pleaded for relief from lycanthropy

events.summary: Avacyn appears at Gatstaf Grotto and offers the afflicted a choice to swear loyalty as guardians.
events.quote: Avacyn offered the afflicted a choice

events.summary: The Gatstaf werewolves accept, and Avacyn transforms the willing into the Wolfir in the Cursemute.
events.quote: she transformed the willing into the Wolfir

events.summary: The Cursemute dulls the Chain Veil's hold on Garruk Wildspeaker.
Avacyn is driven to madness and destroyed; the Cursemute unravels and werewolves regain their hunger.
events.quote: The wolfir faded, and many werewolves regained their savage hunger

relations.quote: she transformed the willing into the Wolfir
devoted to the Church of Avacyn
